## [docker-otel-lgtm](https://github.com/grafana/docker-otel-lgtm)

- **Kind:** Infrastructure

- **Languages:** Shell, Go
- **License:** Apache-2.0
- **Lifecycle:** Active
- **GitHub stars:** 2,168

**Key features**
